page.notes: Page is clear; no illegible words. Doubtful: the reference mark before "sufficiet" is a small dagger-like sign, transcribed as {7} and may be wrong. The left margin uses "*" twice, once for "Joan. 1. 16." and once for "In 1. 2."; the text marks are at "De plenitudine" and "Vasquez" and "jam", so the mapping is uncertain. "Cap. 2. seq. 5." is read as "seq.", with the abbreviation doubtful. Long s is transcribed as plain s (stolus, sit, sed). Running head "ANTIDOTUM" with "Cap.14." as printed. Printed hyphens kept on "ju-stitia", "infini-tam", "ple-nitudinem", "Vas-quez".
